Q5217.reason: UCC 2-207(1) makes an acceptance expressly conditioned on the new loading charge a counteroffer, and nothing shows that counteroffer was accepted.

Q8260.reason: Respiratory water is formed only when O2 accepts electrons at complex IV, so that production stops at once while glycolysis still makes pyruvate and ATP.

Q5585.reason: The question is leading on direct examination of the calling party’s own witness, which is improper because that witness is not adverse.
